note: Replay plan for the SHARDED LiveWhale path (src/livewhale/shard.ts). Responses are keyed by REQUEST ORDER, not by date: the window planner is anchored on `now`, so a date-keyed fixture would stop matching tomorrow. This plan pins the BEHAVIOUR and stays deterministic forever. Sequence: (1) the real recorded at-cap response, which must trigger a halve-and-refetch; (2) and (3) its two halves, both under the cap and sharing 10 source_ids so the cross-window dedupe is exercised; (4+) every remaining window comes back empty, which is what makes the sweep window the union of what was REQUESTED rather than of what came back. Nothing bottoms out at the 1-day floor, so the run must record `ok` — the first time LiveWhale can.
